# Long Gil Studio

> Long Gil Studio is a Vietnamese independent game development studio founded by Huynh Long Gil, aiming to blend AAA quality with indie creativity ("AAA Indie Game").

## Core Projects

### GilongWorld (Sci-Fi Action RPG)
- **URL**: [GilongWorld on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615990/GilongWorld/) / [Official Website](https://gilongworld.com)
- **Description**: An upcoming Sci-Fi Action RPG game. Players master the art of alchemy and potion crafting, tame mysterious creatures, build sci-fi bases, and survive in a dangerous, immersive world.
- **Platforms**: Windows PC.

### Mobile Applications & Games
- **Fruit Dodgeball**: An arcade game where players control a flying ball, collide, and avoid obstacles to score points. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tenHoGil.FruitDodgeball) and [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/do/app/fruit-dodgeball/id6748839575).
- **CTU - TKB - KHHT**: A course registration, scheduling, and learning helper application specifically designed for students of Can Tho University. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Gilong.KHHT) and [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/do/app/ctu-%C4%91%C4%83ng-k%C3%BD-hp-khht/id6748887877).
- **Cute Hide: Query-chan**: A cute hide-and-seek mobile game featuring the anime character Query-chan. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Gilong.CuteHide).
- **Quiz 3000 English Words**: An educational mobile app helping learners memorize the Oxford 3000 core English words through quizzes. Available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Gilong.E3000VocabQuiz).

## About the Founder

- **Founder**: Huynh Long Gil (also known as Gil Huynh Long)
- **Background**: Computer Science graduate from Can Tho University (Class of 2021 - 2025). Unity Developer since May 2022.
- **Skills**: C#, Unity Engine, Software Architecture, Design Patterns, Game Design.
- **Profile**: Detailed info is on the [About Me Page](https://longgilstudio.com/cv.html).
